n = data[0]

62.referencePython:
import sys
from collections import Counter
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n = data[0]
a = data[1:1 + n]
k = data[1 + n]
freq = Counter(a)
if k == 0:
    answer = sum(count * (count - 1) // 2 for count in freq.values())
else:
    answer = sum(count * freq.get(value + k, 0) for value, count in freq.items())
print(answer)
